usedFor: Text-Em-All holds texts and broadcasts, and HubSpot receives a deal through “Create Deal” when “New Text Received” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Text Received” in Text-Em-All, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A reply is a sign of interest, so “Create Deal” puts it in the pipeline.

watchOut: “Update Deal” in HubSpot needs a deal ID, so “Broadcast Status Changes” only fits if you store it.
